pages.text: Use both distinct native functions of one obtained Soul Render, Tidal Claws or Ceraunus.

pages.title: A Second Stance
pages.text: Choose between an earned weapon’s two real functions for the situation.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Soul Render switches rush to phantom-halberd spiral while sneaking. Tidal Claws combines right-click grappling with a tentacle attack. Ceraunus switches anchor throw to a wave fan; Astrape separately launches a lightning spear. If a combat addon is active, follow its actions 1/2/3: that addon owns

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: With the addon, Ceraunus actions 1/2/3 throw, project waves, or leap with lightning/waves; each needs its points.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: The Soul Render addon actions 1/2/3 distinguish dash with halberds, area slam/stun and surrounding halberd summon.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Addon Tidal Claws has dash/laser; Incinerator has charged fireballs and Flame Soul Slash. Use configured actions 2/3 and their real costs.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: The combat patch styles apply only to supported items; they do not make all trophies share one combo.
